mintAuthority.summary: MUSD's only canonical native issuance route is on Mezo: BorrowerOperations opens BTC-collateralized troves at a 110% minimum collateral ratio and InterestRateManager mints accrued interest. The Mezo token owner's 5-of-9 Safe administers the canonical mintList and can authorize arbitrary additional Mezo minters, so canonical issuance remains unbounded-adverse. Ethereum and Base are Wormhole NTT burning-spoke representations; their bridge minting, burn, rate-limit, upgrade, peer, pause, and Guardian-attestation controls are assessed under bridgeRouteRisk.

controls.label: Mezo BorrowerOperations CDP mint route
controls.capDescription: BorrowerOperations currently mints against BTC-collateralized troves at a 110% minimum collateral ratio; InterestRateManager 0x4a453700d157717Fe02fB62E7700ED7845048285 is a separate accrued-interest minter. BorrowerOperations is an upgradeable transparent proxy: ProxyAdmin 0x778f4ef6cbe4492a6c87abab98821e4242663e58 is owned by the Mezo protocol Safe, so the current collateral constraint is not immutable.
controls.evidence: At Mezo block 11179505 (2026-08-16, https://jsonrpc-mezo.boar.network): mintList(0x44b1bac67dDA612a41a58AAf779143B181dEe031) = true and mintList(InterestRateManager 0x4a453700d157717Fe02fB62E7700ED7845048285) = true on the MUSD token. The pinned MUSD.sol source shows mint() requires mintList[msg.sender] and the Liquity system contracts are the CDP mint route; BorrowerOperations issuance is economically bounded by BTC collateral at the 110% MCR, while the owner-controlled allowlist remains a separate arbitrary-minter surface.

controls.label: Mezo protocol owner Safe (canonical MUSD token owner)
controls.capDescription: The Mezo owner Safe administers the canonical token's mintList/burnList allowlists (addToMintList/addToBurnList are onlyOwner in MUSD.sol), so it can authorize arbitrary new Mezo minters; it does not itself call mint(). The same Safe's Ethereum/Base token and NTT-manager ownership is bridge administration reviewed separately under bridgeRouteRisk.

controls.evidence: At canonical Mezo block 12270639 on 2026-10-03, MUSD mintList(this address)=true, this proxy's musd() returns the exact canonical MUSD token, and its EIP-1967 implementation is 0x3ea98a11d349b515e628c1cc74ca999230744c43. Both proxy and current EnclaveDebtManager implementation are fully verified in the official explorer backend. The implementation's openPosition() is ENCLAVE_ROLE-gated and directly calls musd.mint(); increaseDebt() also issues MUSD for an active Enclave position. GOVERNANCE_ROLE can change mintCap, so the observed local ceiling is not an immutable end-to-end economic bound. The proxy's embedded ProxyAdmin 0x752f66f1d513e8681cdeffdc16e7f2e1f31ae015 owner() returns the protocol Safe at the same pin. This resolves the third minter's native debt-manager identity, not a complete Safe execution/permission or collateral-reconciliation census; no two-day delay or favorable collateral-gated semantics is inferred.

review.evidence: Canonical Mezo re-review at block 12220336 on 2026-10-01: MUSD and the BorrowerOperations ProxyAdmin are owned by the recorded 5-of-9 protocol Safe. BorrowerOperations is a transparent proxy with implementation 0x501670bbbe2ec8c11449c28c0c9e6677d5ea9b61 and ProxyAdmin 0x778f4ef6cbe4492a6c87abab98821e4242663e58; immutable MUSD token bytecode does not make mint-critical CDP logic immutable. Canonical Safe module pagination is empty and the standard guard storage slot is zero, superseding the 2026-08-16 unresolved getter observation for this chain only. Complete MintListAddressAdded/MintListAddressRemoved log census from genesis through block 12220336, in 10000-block chunks, found three additions and no removals: BorrowerOperations and InterestRateManager at block 178718, and 0x2c5e9afbb670c4a61ac2dcad62c258ee2391389a at block 8550826. All three remain mintList=true. The third address requires separate transfer-rail classification and liability reconciliation; the two CDP paths are not the complete canonical token mint allowlist. Source and docs establish the owner can authorize uncapped additional minters; no dated reconciliation covering every allowlisted mint path was located. EconomicCapSemantics remains unbounded and reconciliation remains unknown. The earlier Ethereum/Base NTT bridge review is preserved under bridgeRouteRisk and is not refreshed by these Mezo-only reads.
